cases.input: An assertion has since lapsed but as-of falls inside validity.
cases.expect: It may be returned for that as-of if evidence was in force; no stored expired flag is consulted.

cases.input: The same assertion is queried after validTo.
cases.expect: It cannot support current competence.

cases.input: A capability is revalidated.
cases.expect: A successor assertion is created and predecessor validity is unchanged.

cases.input: An assertion is revoked ab initio.
cases.expect: It supports no as-of instant but its record and lineage remain readable.

cases.input: An assertion is revoked prospectively.
cases.expect: Earlier support remains queryable and later support is excluded.

cases.input: A self assertion names another person as asserter.
cases.expect: The assertion must be rejected.

cases.input: A self assertion claims verified assurance.
cases.expect: The assertion must be rejected.

cases.input: Basis assessment-act has no assessmentRef.
cases.expect: The assertion must be rejected.

cases.input: Basis artifact-evidence has no evidenceRefs.
cases.expect: The assertion must be rejected.

cases.input: An assessor claim cites an assessment act and artifacts.
cases.expect: One assertion records both axes without duplicate claims.

cases.input: Capability was observed in March and recorded in June.
cases.expect: Decay uses March while known-at uses June.

cases.input: Open-ended assertion relies on an expired credential.
cases.expect: It cannot support current competence.

cases.input: A decay threshold passes.
cases.expect: No new lower assertion or level mutation occurs.

cases.input: Two methods/scales are combined into a composite level.
cases.expect: The stored merge must be rejected; any selection is a named query policy only.

cases.input: A staffing filter treats no assertion as not competent.
cases.expect: The inference must be rejected unless explicitly disclosed as process policy.

cases.input: A staffing query requests special-category evidence content.
cases.expect: Evidence content is withheld and the attempt is recorded.

cases.input: A valid erasure request applies.
cases.expect: The assertion becomes a non-supporting tombstone while identity and audit lineage remain.

cases.input: definitionVersionRef has only a concept code.
cases.expect: The assertion must be rejected.

cases.input: asserterRef resolves to no declared party master.
cases.expect: The assertion must be rejected or held, never accepted as text.

cases.input: Course completion attempts to create expert proficiency.
cases.expect: No assertion is created.

cases.input: Role occupancy is treated as evidence.
cases.expect: No assertion is created.

cases.input: A scale mapping is used to mint a target assertion.
cases.expect: No assertion is created.

cases.input: Credential title matches definition label but has no claim binding.
cases.expect: Coverage is not inferred.

cases.input: An assertion is superseded then withdrawn.
cases.expect: All records remain resolvable and only eligible ones support the requested as-of.

cases.input: An assertion changes state without declared operation and authority.
cases.expect: The transition must be rejected.

cases.input: A consumer treats the review slug as a registry ID.
cases.expect: The registry claim must be rejected.
